newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota Feb domestic output down 13.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Toyota Feb domestic output down 13.5 pct.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Friday that its domestic vehicle production fell 13.5 percent in February from a year earlier to 269,695 vehicles.
Toyota's exports fell 17.5 percent in February from a year earlier to 89,282 vehicles.
Toyota's February domestic production fell for the first time in eight months on a year-on-year basis, due to a fire at a parts supplier on February 1.
That incident also caused its vehicle exports to fall year-on-year for the first time in two months, a Toyota spokesman said.

But Toyota's domestic sales rose for the sixth month in a row, reflecting persistent strong demand for new recreational vehicles such as its Ipsum, Spacio, Estima series, Prado and Camry Gracia Wagon, he said.
